title: Leo Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Leo (July 23 – August 22) is the radiant fire sign ruled by the Sun. Generous, confident and creative, Leo was born to shine and to make others shine too.
personality: Leo brings warmth to every room. They love to create, perform and celebrate, and they have a big heart for the people they love. Confident on the outside, they also need appreciation and loyalty in return. Leos are proud, playful and brave, and when they believe in something, they give it everything.
love: Leo loves big: grand gestures, romance and lots of affection. They want a partner who admires them and whom they can be proud of. Respect and compliments go a long way.
career: Leo shines in leadership, entertainment, design, events, marketing, teaching and any role with an audience and room for creativity.
friendship: Leo is the friend who throws the party, hypes you up and stands by you in public and in private.

faq.q: What is the Leo personality like?
faq.ans: Leo is confident, generous, creative and loves to shine and be appreciated.

faq.q: Who is Leo most compatible with?
faq.ans: Leo often matches well with Aries, Sagittarius and Libra.

faq.q: What is the ruling planet of Leo?
faq.ans: Leo is ruled by the Sun, the center of the solar system, which fits its radiant personality.
